name: Harold
tagline: A quiet Tesla watcher that stays read-only and pings you only when it matters
description: Watches your Tesla through the official Tesla Fleet API, read-only and without ever waking the car, and messages you only when something needs you, like low battery or a door left unlocked. It never shares your location or VIN, sends commands only if you turn on full access and ask in chat, and before setup it can read a Tesla app screenshot you paste. Harold is an independent bot made by an owner. It isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Tesla.
author: BowieHole
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
